investigation_notes.Previous Alert Notes: SOC-1988 (2026-01-04) was a similar GUID-based Get-ADGroup lookup on the same endpoint and user; it was closed as a false positive after IT confirmed the activity was part of a manual audit by the user, who is a Senior Systems Administrator.
investigation_notes.Description: A PowerShell Get-ADGroup GUID lookup was executed on MGMT-TERM-01 by user j.smith, which triggered the alert. The scriptblock shows a single Active Directory GUID lookup and there are no file paths, process hashes, or external IP indicators associated with the execution. A highly similar alert on the same host and user was previously closed as a false positive after IT verification that the lookup was part of an audit, which reduces the likelihood of malicious intent. Based on the benign nature of the command, lack of anomalous execution artifacts, and corroborating historical context, this alert is assessed as Low Priority.
